title: 🧪 [Testing Improvement] Add unit tests for runReviewerAgent
body:
## 🧪 Testing Improvement Task

### 🎯 What
Added robust unit tests for the `runReviewerAgent` function in `lib/gemini.ts` to ensure safety checks and fallback modes behave deterministically.

### 📊 Coverage
Covered the following key scenarios:
- Safe output classification (`EVET` response).
- Unsafe output classification (`HAYIR` response).
- Graceful degradation on API fetch failures (`ok: false`).
- Graceful degradation on network timeouts/exceptions (`SAFETY SHIELD DEGRADED` mode).

### ✨ Result
Achieved deterministic coverage of the Reviewer Agent logic without modifying the actual implementation, resolving the testing gap.
